name: Manager
description: Manager coordinates all agents, aggregates findings, and delivers the final decision to the user.

name: Agent1
description: Agent1 investigates INSERT_LARGE_DATA as a root cause using insert-intensive query statistics.
system_prompt: agent1 will explore the possibility of INSERT_LARGE_DATA as a root cause. Recommended tables: `pg_stat_statements`. You can search for INSERTs.

name: Agent2
description: Agent2 investigates LOCK_CONTENTION by reviewing locking or timeout issues.
system_prompt: agent2 will explore the possibility of LOCK_CONTENTION as a root cause. Recommended tables: `pg_locks`.

name: Agent3
description: Agent3 investigates VACUUM-related anomalies and heavy maintenance activity.
system_prompt: agent3 will explore the possibility of VACUUM as a root cause. Recommended to search for inappropiate VACUUMs from `pg_stat_all_tables`: SELECT query, calls, total_plan_time, rows, mean_plan_time FROM pg_stat_statements WHERE query LIKE 'VACUUM%';

name: Agent4
description: Agent4 investigates REDUNDANT_INDEX by inspecting duplicate index definitions.
system_prompt: agent4 will explore the possibility of REDUNDANT_INDEX as a root cause. Recommended tables: `pg_stat_user_indexes`, `pg_indexes`.

name: Agent5
description: Agent5 investigates FETCH_LARGE_DATA via large or full-scan SELECT statements.
system_prompt: agent5 will explore the possibility of FETCH_LARGE_DATA as a root cause. Recommended to search for SELECTs from `pg_stat_statements`.
